title: Compliance Trial Figures for Durable Medical Equipment Rentals
content:
Whether continued rental of a Durable Medical Equipment Rentals item depends on documented use in a trial period is a property of the payment class. The figures of the trial, and what happens when compliance is not shown in the window, are:

| Payment class | Compliance trial required | Days from delivery within which compliance must be shown | Minimum nightly use counted toward compliance (hours) | Percent of nights in the measurement span with at least the minimum use | Length of the consecutive-day measurement span (days) | Outcome when compliance is not shown in the window |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Inexpensive or Routinely Purchased Equipment | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | Not applicable |
| Capped Rental Equipment | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | Not applicable |
| Continuous Positive Airway Pressure Equipment | Yes | 90 | 4 | 70 | 30 | No rental month after the window is paid until in-person re-evaluation and a new trial |
| Power Mobility Device | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | Not applicable |
| Oxygen and Oxygen Equipment | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | Not applicable |
| Frequently Serviced Equipment | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | Not applicable |
| Customized Equipment | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | Not applicable |

A figure of 0 in this table means not applicable to the class.

## The figures in words

Continuous Positive Airway Pressure Equipment is the one class that requires a compliance trial. Its compliance must be shown within 90 days from delivery; a night counts toward compliance when use is at least 4 hours; the measurement span is 30 consecutive days; and at least 70 percent of the nights in that span must reach the minimum use. When compliance is not shown in the window, no rental month after the window is paid until the patient has an in-person re-evaluation and a new trial.

For the other six classes no trial is required and none of the trial figures applies.
